pages.text: Right-click the altar with an empty hand:$(li)Left: the recognised tier and factor, and what the next tier still needs$(li)Middle: prayer spots, believers praying now and over 7 days, favor today, estimated daily output (an estimate only), and accrual while you are away$(li)Right: what is missing; unloaded chunks, too-low age and unreachable spots are each named

Press "Highlight gaps" and outlines appear in the world for 10 seconds; their $(l)shapes$() mean:$(li)□ scanned area, counted columns$(li)☒ missing or altar-covering blocks, unlit braziers$(li)⬚ columns too short or on the ground$(li)▮ whole columns without roof$(li)▁ prayer spots$(br2)Only lines are drawn; no blocks are placed.
